lines.text: Later. The Common Table. Aruun sets something down very carefully.
A sliver of Thoughtstone, smaller than a thumbnail. It turns on the tabletop until it points at Morrow. Then it stops.
Thoughtstone near Morrow aligns its internal structure toward it. We've seen it in the lab. Never in the field.
And nobody cuts Morrow open to find out why. Morrow is not a sample.
I tried reading it. It has too many futures. Every one of them is pointing the same way.
Mineral. Organism. Network. Memory medium. Or something without a human category.
Mara. Handler. Lovely work out there. One more thing before you pretend not to answer.
Your field log says a Thoughtstone sliver turned to face the mace on its own. I would very much like to see that. Call me when you want to compare notes.
...He's going to be impossible about this.
He was always going to be. That one I didn't need the crown for.
